scope: Ten distinct Commons file pages for Solomon Islands, Papua New Guinea, Kiribati, Tuvalu and Federated States of Micronesia. Checked against 80 earlier records from main and PR #5.
method: Read the exact Commons file-description pages for credited creator, location/subject description and declared licence. Wikimedia's metadata and Flickr review notices are source evidence, not an independent pixel or complete copyright-chain audit.
displayRequirements: Before publishing inspect actual image pixels, verify current file page and rights, display author/file-page/licence/changes credits, comply with ShareAlike for adaptations, and avoid treating country gateway pin coordinates as exact photo locations. CC0 author credit is courteous.
